text: 9月13日，2026浦江创新论坛“太空算力产业生态论坛”在上海举行。“明珠星座计划”正式启动。该计划长期目标是建设吉瓦级天基计算星座，围绕国产算力载荷、光计算载荷、新型能源系统等方向开展在轨验证，随后逐步进入首批卫星部署和规模组网阶段，计划到2030年逐步建成全球覆盖、天地协同、自主可控的太空智能算力基础设施和服务网络。
text_en: On September 13, the 2026 Pujiang Innovation Forum's "Space Computing Power Industry Ecosystem Forum" was held in Shanghai. The "Mingzhu Constellation Plan" was officially launched. The plan's long-term goal is to build a gigawatt-level space-based computing constellation, conducting in-orbit verification in areas such as domestic computing payloads, optical computing payloads, and new energy systems, then gradually entering the initial satellite deployment and large-scale networking stage, with plans to progressively build a globally covered, space-ground coordinated, independently controllable space intelligent computing infrastructure and service network by 2030.
